summary: Innodata Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an equity distribution agreement with multiple sales agents to sell up to $300 million of common stock through an at-the-market offering under its existing S-3 shelf registration statement. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The company has no obligation to sell shares and may suspend or terminate the offering at any time. Sales agents receive up to 2.0% commission. The filing contains no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, tenders, or restructuring.
